thread:
maria_ops: FYI incoming H100 pallet from VendorX landed FRA but customs flagged a thermal variance on 3/20 units :thermometer:
paul_procurement: ugh. which AWB? any SKUs affected?
liam_logistics: AWB 7812345678, SKUs H100-24GB x20. Manifest shows 3 units flagged with irregular temp profile on arrival scan.
alex_vendor: Confirming — our carrier reported an alarm during air transit, they logged an incident but units shipped as-is. We're pulling the pre-shipment thermal logs now.
maria_ops: Can we hold the whole shipment at depot until we decide RMA vs local repair? Customs is asking for disposition.
jen_sre: From infra side, we need usable units asap. Can we isolate the flagged serials and release the rest to provisioning?
liam_logistics: Depot can segregate. Proposal: isolate the 3 flagged units into hold bin, customs release for remaining 17. Need vendor OK for partial release.
paul_procurement: Alex — can VendorX accept partial release and process RMA for flagged units? Also what's the shelf-life/repairable status? If they're DOA vs repairable changes logistics.
alex_vendor: We can accept partial release. For the 3 units: initial assessment says possible thermal stress — may be repairable but need depot inspection. We'll cover RMA shipping cost if units fail repair.
jen_sre: Timeline impacts: if we release 17, we can provision ~85% of the expected capacity. But cluster scheduling needs exact ETA for replacements to avoid preemption churn.
sophie_finance: Quick note — if vendor covers RMA freight but not refurbishment, need to confirm crediting policy. We prefer vendor cover replacement cost for DOA.
paul_procurement: Alex, please provide an RMA SLA: pickup ETA, depot destination, and whether vendor will expedite replacements. Also confirm insurance coverage and HS code docs for customs.
alex_vendor: RMA SLA: pickup arranged within 48h, replacement air shipment 72-96h after depot confirms failure. Carrier and insurance on our account for RMA leg. HS code paperwork will be emailed to liam by EOD.
liam_logistics: Sounds good. I'll update customs agent and request partial release for 17 units. Need formal RMA number before depot begins teardown.
maria_ops: Can rma_bot create a case so depot has a single ref?
rma_bot: RMA case created: RMA-2024-4872. Pickup window 48h. Depot code: FRA-DEP-17. Link: https://rma.internal/RMA-2024-4872
jen_sre: Once depot confirms repair vs replace, can we get a 2-hour heads-up? We'll shift canary fleets accordingly.
sophie_finance: Also flag budget owner — if vendor delays >7 days and we need emergency spot buys, we may need PO approval for one-off short-term leases.
paul_procurement: Noted. I'll set a 7-day escalation to procurement lead.
liam_logistics: One operational ask: depot needs packing photos and the carrier incident report for customs release. Alex, can you push those now?
alex_vendor: On it — photos and carrier IORT attached in vendor portal, I'll DM liam the AWB docs.
maria_ops: Great. For tracking, I'll create a quick Kanban card under infra-provisioning and tag jen_sre + liam_logistics.
jen_sre: Thx. If replacements ship from APAC, alert about region constraints — we prefer EU stock to avoid cross-border delays.
alex_vendor: We'll prioritize EU pool first. If unavailable we ship from APAC with DDP to minimize customs friction.
paul_procurement: Final: agree partial release, vendor-funded RMA freight, depot inspection for repair/replace, RMA-2024-4872 active. We'll reconvene if repair fails. :thumbsup:
liam_logistics: I'll post customs clearance update in channel when partial release is approved.
maria_ops: Closing loop — provisioning will consume released units after depot QC. Thanks everyone.
